name: mado-finding-evidence-audit
authority: artifact arithmetic and evidence labels only; not semantic correctness, authentication, admission or promotion

bundle.sha256: actual lowercase SHA256 of snapshot bytes

snapshot.findings: list of objects, each explicit evidence observed|lead and nonempty class and command strings
snapshot.files: nonempty list of objects, each eval_unparsed and unparsed_spawns nonnegative exact ints

rules: At least one files member is required; findings may legitimately be empty
Sum errors from all file eval_unparsed and unparsed_spawns counters
Claim total, observed, lead and errors each equal the actual corresponding count
clean:true only if findings empty and errors zero
Missing/invalid evidence markers are uncertainty, never silently observed
No path escape or symlink is accepted; all snapshot bytes are bounded to 2MiB
Duplicate JSON keys, malformed JSON, booleans-as-counts, negative counts and nonfinite numbers are invalid
Snapshot digest is checked before verdict comparison

preimplementation_proposal_shape.rationale: independently reasoned semantics; do not measure or read candidate code
